question_text: Explain one safety concern when an ML-controlled vehicle tested on a narrow training set is deployed on public roads.
adaptation_rationale: Retains deployment-safety concern through explicit ethical implications of ML; no simulation-system taxonomy.
solution: Unfamiliar weather or pedestrians may differ from training examples, causing unreliable predictions. An incorrect braking/steering decision can injure people. Evaluation on diverse conditions and a safe fallback are therefore needed before deployment; success on familiar examples alone is insufficient.

marking_points.criterion: Develops concrete harm to road users.

partial_credit_notes: Award independent criteria up to the stated total; accept equivalent technically correct wording/solutions.
